availability: Report/evidence publication only. C and D used local launcher/adapter changes; no updated APC image or runtime patch is published with this report.
notes: Stored server-metadata.json is the base profile before launcher overrides. C/D effectively enable prefix caching and Mamba align; compact replay/prefill/conv registrations are disabled.
D restores only native recurrent prefill while retaining stock cache/state/convolution/decode ownership.
A/B/C/D 8K/40K runs use 65536 context, 5 GiB cache, max_num_seqs=1. D long uses 160000 context, 8 GiB cache, max_num_seqs=1.
D concurrency smoke uses max_num_seqs=8; client C1/2/4/8 is functional evidence, not a warmed throughput comparison or proof of eight simultaneously scheduled requests.
All serving arms requested FULL graphs; effective mode was FULL_DECODE_ONLY.
Request/response and metric data are original bytes except local filesystem references normalized to archive-relative paths in metadata. Original and exported hashes are both retained.
HTTP benchmark client portability changes only replace a local helper import path. No compiler/runtime implementation is included.
